title: Invite
lead: HiveVoice grows when people take each other along. Here you share the app, invite people and see where somebody is still missing near you.

share.qrHint: Scan it with the camera of a phone.
share.appText: I use HiveVoice: people from our area propose things, discuss fairly and vote in secret. Join us:
share.contentPrivate: This is not public. Whoever should see it gets an invitation.
share.contentText: Have a look at this on HiveVoice:

invite.title: Invitations
invite.mode_open: Registration is open. Invitation codes are not needed right now.
invite.mode_invite: For now people join with an invitation code or two vouches.
invite.leftNone: You have no invitations left right now. New ones come when the people you invited stay.
invite.voucherText: Nobody else sees this. If an invited person breaks the rules you will hear about it.
invite.redeemTitle: Do you have an invitation code?
invite.needCode: Your account still needs an invitation code or two vouches. You can read already.

page.title: You were invited
page.text: Somebody invited you to HiveVoice. People from their area propose things here, discuss fairly and vote in secret.
page.signIn: Sign in or create an account
page.used: This code is used, expired or withdrawn.
page.own: This is your own code. Pass it on to somebody else.

gaps.title: Where somebody is missing near you
gaps.text: People already write about these topics in your area, but nobody has taken on the responsibility yet:
gaps.invite: Invite somebody who knows the topic
gaps.none: All topics near you have somebody responsible already. Thank you!

admin.title: Registration
admin.text: Open: anybody can sign up. By invitation: new accounts need an invitation code or two vouches before they found groups or start initiatives. Existing accounts stay as they are.
admin.mintText: For the start-up phase when nobody can invite yet. The codes are valid for 30 days.
